name: koubo-editing-assistant
description: Talking-head video editor: cuts retakes and pauses, adds picture-in-picture, cards, quote cards and captions, and delivers the final video; also makes screenshot explainers.

displayDescription.en: Send a talking-head video and get a finished cut: retakes and pauses removed, picture-in-picture, key-point cards, quote cards and captions added. Also makes screenshot explainers.
displayDescription.zh: 发来出镜口播视频，自动剪掉口误和停顿，加小窗、要点卡、金句卡和字幕，直接出成片，也能做截图科普动画

defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is my talking-head video. Please edit and package it, and show me the cut list and style templates first.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我出镜录的口播视频，帮我剪辑加包装，先给我剪辑单和模版图。

quickPrompts.en: Here is my talking-head video. Please edit and package it, and show me the cut list and style templates first.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我出镜录的口播视频，帮我剪辑加包装，先给我剪辑单和模版图。

quickPrompts.en: I want an explainer video about a piece of software. Here are the outline and screenshots; please write the voiceover script first.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做一条讲清楚某个软件的科普视频，大致内容和截图发你，先帮我写口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Here are my recorded video and a few screenshots. Turn them into an explainer with annotated screenshot animations.
quickPrompts.zh: 录好的口播视频和几张截图发你，帮我做成截图配圈注动画的科普视频。
